messages:
emily-finance: Heads up 3 GreenLeaf Health3 ACH microdeposits are still pending for ACH-7210. Customer says they submitted bank details 48h ago. Our ledger shows status `microdeposit_pending` but the bank returned `account_number_mismatch` once. Can payments advise next steps? cc @sam-payments @laura-support

sam-payments: Thanks Emily. If the bank returned `account_number_mismatch` at least once, that suggests the account/routing didn't match what the bank expects. Microdeposits can still be pending if the tokenization succeeded but downstream verification failed.

sam-payments: Options: 1) Ask customer to re-enter account/routing (often their bank app autofills incorrectly), 2) Send a ACH setup link that re-tokenizes with our connector, or 3) Offer wire as a one-time fallback and mark invoice as "pending-wire".

laura-support: Customer is on a tight renewal window and worried about service interruption. They asked if we can "just take the card" they used last quarter 3 we don't have a card on file. They prefer wire if ACH won't clear today.

nora-ops: FYI, there was a short outage on the ACH connector between 2026-03-17T02:30-03:10Z that delayed some microdeposits and verifications. We triaged and fixed the connector, but some cases need manual re-submission. Recommend re-send the setup link and give the customer a 48h window.

emily-finance: For accounting: if we accept a wire, do we need any special account code or memo to tie to invoice INV-AC-7210? Also who approves fee coverage for a waived domestic wire fee?

sam-payments: If wire: instruct payments ops to include invoice id in wire memo exactly as "INV:INV-AC-7210" and add internal tag `wire-manual`. GL folks note: wires settle differently than cards; record as "manual_receipt" until bank settles.

sam-payments: Fee policy: standard domestic incoming wire fees are passed to customer unless we authorize a waiver. For churn-risk renewals we can sign off on waived fee with finance manager sign-off.

emily-finance: Can we get sign-off here? Customer is high-touch. If we take wire, waive the $15 incoming fee. @mike-cfo please advise.

mike-cfo: Approve one-time waiver for GreenLeaf Health for this renewal. Document reason in invoice comments and flag for quarter-end review. No recurring waivers.

billing-bot: Microdeposit status: ACH-7210: pending (last_event=account_number_mismatch), retry_window opens at 2216086523. Manual-setup-link-sent=false.

laura-support: I'll send the ACH setup link now and include the wire fallback instructions with the exact memo string. I'll also attach a screenshot checklist so they double-check routing number vs account number.

sam-payments: Thanks. If they still fail after re-submit, Laura open a support ticket to request an expedited manual verify (requires bank letter or statement). If they opt for wire, payments-ops use payment channel #payments-ops to confirm receipt and then Emily will reconcile.

emily-finance: Noted. I'll log the waiver and update AR: "GreenLeaf Health 3 incoming wire approved, $15 fee waived, reason: retention/renewal. Do not mark paid until bank confirmation."

laura-support: Sent ACH link at 2216001200. Customer replied: "We resubmitted; bank app asked for microdeposit verification code, we'll confirm in 24h."

emily-finance: Great. I'll keep invoice open and wait 24-48h. If no confirmation, proceed with wire and follow the memo and waiver steps.

laura-support: Will update ticket. GreenLeaf asked if we can email the wire instructions PDF 3 sending now.

emily-finance: Thanks everyone. Will close this loop once settled.
